title: a cell that the diagram does not carry is an absent cell and not a cell that is led elsewhere
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D1) for the fourth time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 90 to 92 named one finding that touches it (F29).  The code of the kernel and the generator are honest; the proof named a subject that is not there.  The wave touches no code of the kernel and no file of the generator.  (1) **The comparison reported an absent cell as a cell that is led elsewhere**: the cell `(post-decide nudge . deciding)' is not in the diagram at all -- no arrow of the diagram carries its label -- and the comparison fell out of its branches into a guess by the order of the table: it answered "the generator reads the table but leads the cell elsewhere: the cell (post-decide nudge deciding) is drawn as (idle --> deciding : weird)".  A refusal with a subject that is not there sends the reader to the generator, and the defect is in the diagram.  (2) **The comparison now tells the cases apart by content and not by order**: the branch of the guess by the order is gone, and every kind of the defect has a subject that is there -- `absent' (no arrow of the diagram carries the label of the cell), `label' (the label of the cell is in the diagram and the ends of its arrow are not the ends of the cell), `wrong-label' (the ends of the cell are in the diagram and the label of its arrow is not the label of the cell), `twice' (the table of the machine names the same cell more than once and the diagram carries fewer arrows for it than the table names cells), `twice-arrow' (the diagram carries the same arrow more than once and the cell of the table has no arrow of its own), `count' (the number of the arrows and the number of the cells are not the same) and `extra-arrow' (the diagram carries an arrow that the table of the machine does not name).  (3) **The check proves this on stands of its own**: four small tables of cells and four small diagrams, written in the file of the check and not read out of the kernel, on which the comparison must name the kind of the defect and must not name another one.  A comparison that cannot say "absent" cannot prove that the diagram carries every cell of the table, and the check says so.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture of the site: the check compares the cells of the table with the arrows of the diagram, and the pictures of the site itself are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is three prices.  (a) **The check does not forbid the duplicate in the table itself**: a table that names a cell twice and a diagram that carries that arrow twice are green here -- the generator draws one arrow for every cell, so such a diagram is the correct drawing of such a table.  The duplicate is forbidden in the place where it belongs: the machine has a unit test of its own (`yeah-loop-no-label-is-declared-twice-for-one-state', tests/unit/test-yeah-loop.el), and the runtime takes the first match, so the second row is dead weight.  The wave says where the class is closed and does not pretend to close it twice.  (b) **A kind of the defect is a thing to read**: the kinds are named apart now, and the names of the wave 87 are not in the file of the check under those names any more -- the kind `leads' of the wave 87 is named `label' now, the kind `label' of the wave 87 is named `wrong-label' now, and the kind `extra-arrow' is new; the cases that the kinds name are the same cases, and the text of every refusal says what is there.  (c) The comparison goes by content and not by order: the order of the arrows is not measured, and the objection (c) of wave 87 stands.  Two more objections of wave 87 stand as well: the rule of the identifier of PlantUML is written twice (in the generator and in the check) and the pipeline in a tree without the kernel is measured only in the case "no kernel" (the answer 3) and not in the case "the generator answered 1".
refuted_by: the diagram of the repository is not the file that the generator writes from the current code, or the generator does not read the table of the machine, or the generator does not read the list of the states, or the diagram does not carry every cell and every state of the machine, or an arrow of the diagram carries ends that are not the ends of its cell, or a cell that the diagram does not carry at all is named a cell that is led elsewhere, or a cell that the table of the machine names twice is called an absent cell, or the pipeline does not draw the machine in both themes, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the machine cannot be generated, or the pipeline draws a picture when the generation of the machine failed, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code' is the same, the text says that a cell that the diagram does not carry at all is named an absent cell and not a cell that is led elsewhere; the `falsifier' names the new refusal, and the `control' is the same.  Twenty controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-21 -- nine by the writer of the wave and eleven more by the parent, and the parent's eleven were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0.  (2) **The unit control of the finding**: the comparison program is fed a file of cells and a diagram in which the arrow of the cell `(post-decide nudge . deciding)' is replaced by a foreign one (`idle --> deciding : weird').  Before the wave it answered `label post-decide nudge deciding idle --> deciding : weird'; now it answers `absent post-decide nudge deciding' and `extra-arrow idle --> deciding : weird', and the words "leads the cell elsewhere" are in no answer.  (3) The same label and other ends -- the kind `label'; the ends of the cell and another label -- the kind `wrong-label'; thirty arrows against thirty-one cells -- the kind `absent'; the table names the same cell twice -- the kind `twice' and not `absent', as the wave 92 wanted.  (4) **The parent's own controls, made independently**: the program of the comparison was taken out of the file of the check and run on tables of its own, and the six cases were told apart -- `absent', `label', `wrong-label', `twice', `extra-arrow' and the count; the call of the comparison was broken (the branch of the duplicate was made to call the branch of the absent cell) and the check fell by its own refusal; the branch of the absent cell was broken (the comparison can never say "absent") and the stands of the check fell; the registered control of the claim -- the table is changed and the diagram is not written again -- the code 1.  (5) **The kind and its subject were compared one by one**: the branch `absent' says "the cell ... is not in the diagram" and not "leads the cell elsewhere"; the branch `label' says "leads the cell elsewhere"; the branch `wrong-label' says "writes the label of the cell wrong"; the branch of the guess by the order is gone.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 884 lines and 40.2 kB (the wave 92 one was 762 lines and 33.5 kB); the file of the kernel and the file of the generator were not touched by this wave, and the branch holds two commits.
